summary: A searchable, filterable users list with a New user action, a role filter and a table with user cell and status chip.
use: Admin list pages where the user searches, filters by one field and acts on rows.
spec: `{#snippet actions()}` holds `<Button variant="filled" size="sm">` with `<Plus size={14} />` and the label New user
`{#snippet filters(list)}` renders `<FilterGroup options={roleOpts} value={list.filters['role'] ?? 'all'} onchange={(v) => list.setFilter('role', v)} />`
`{#snippet children(list)}` renders a `SimpleTable` over `{#each list.rows as u (u.id)}` with `<UserCell name={u.name} email={u.email} />` and `<StatusChip`
